text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who achieved the undefeated 
Classic Triple Crown, Symboli Rudolf. She 
eagerly awaits Mejiro Ramonu achieving the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf runs for the future of 
racing. Mejiro Ramonu runs for love. Both 
aim for the pinnacle, yet their driving 
passions are worlds apart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the Trainer couldn't help but 
hope for a future where the two would 
clash in a race.
